findings_qualitative.value: Protostar candidates correlate positionally with the newly found Northeastern Arm

evidence.quote: There is a good positional correlation between the protostar candidates detected by JVLA at 34 GHz and the ionized gas streamer, Northeastern Arm

claims.hypothesis: Do the NA and EA streamers follow the previously derived Keplerian orbits?
claims.experiment: Compare H42α distribution at 70-90 km/s with Zhao et al. 2009 trajectories
claims.result: Outer parts deviate from inner-region orbits

evidence.quote: the Northern Arm(NA) and Eastern Arm(EA) in their outer regions somewhat deviate from the Keplerian orbits

claims.hypothesis: Is the Bar on an independent Keplerian orbit?
claims.experiment: Compare Bar PV ridge with analytic eccentric orbits

evidence.quote: the streamer corresponding to the Bar of the GCMS has a Keplerian orbit with an eccentricity of $e\sim0.8$

claims.hypothesis: Do Te and ne increase toward Sgr A*?
claims.experiment: LTE Te and ne at selected positions
claims.result: Both increase in NA and EA, without lateral expansion

evidence.quote: We found that the electron density in the NA and EA also increases with approaching Sgr A\* without the lateral expansion of the gas streamers.

claims.hypothesis: Are the protostar candidates tied to ionized streamers?
claims.experiment: Overlay JVLA 34 GHz candidates on H42α NEA
claims.result: Candidates are concentrated in the NEA
claims.finding: Candidates formed in the streamer and were carried inward

evidence.loc: Protostar Candidates in the Galactic Center Mini-spiral
evidence.quote: This good positional correlation indicates that the protostar candidates are physically associated with the NEA.
